pages.text: The Ender Dragon has $(bold)150,000 HP$() and pays $(bold)750,000 XP$(). It fights in four phases.$(br2)$(bold)75%$(): Shadow phantoms dive on everyone.$(br)$(bold)50%$(): enrage. More phantoms and a Void barrage of fire from above. Keep moving.
$(bold)25%$(): second wind. It heals once and summons the $(bold)Herald of the Void$(), a netherite mini-boss. Kill the Herald first; it always drops its sword.$(br)Then finish the dragon.
Bring Ignitium or the best set you have, Protection VII from boss drops, Feather Falling, a Charm of Undying, Farmer's Delight meals, and a party.
